text:
ana-sales: Quick flag 1: Northshore Health signed LOI. They're asking for a capacity appendix for the presales packet: recommended reserved GPUs, autoscale policy, failure modes, and answers for their security/compliance sheet. Need a short runnable plan by EOD.

rico-se: Nice! Do we have their traffic shape? steady qps vs spiky?

ana-sales: They expect 6k RPS peak for embeddings+chat during weekday mornings (08:00-11:00 local), baseline ~900 RPS. Spikes up to 8k for 59 minutes. P95 latency target 400ms.

lina-ml: Model split: 50% small embedding jobs, 50% chat gen. Gen avg tokens 90, context ~1024. We'll use int8 quantized chat models; embeddings on CPU-optimized instances.

sam-platform: Rough back-of-envelope: for mixed workload to meet 6k sustained with quantized gen, ballpark 5 x A10-equivalent workers plus 2 workers dedicated for embeddings to avoid head-of-line blocking. That assumes 1.5x batching and warmed KV.

ira-sre: Operational notes: if they insist on AZ-affinity for session stickiness, that reduces effective capacity by ~20% unless we overprovision per AZ. Also call out evictions: reserved pools + burst credits recommended.

ana-sales: They specifically asked: can we guarantee no throttling during their 5-minute spikes? And what costs for reserved vs pay-as-you-go burst?

rico-se: We can't guarantee absolute no throttling without excess overcommit. Options: 1) reserve capacity sized for peak (higher monthly cost), 2) reserve baseline + burst credits for short spikes, 3) autoscale with prewarm windows and a small cold-lane fallback.

sam-platform: Cost sketch snippet I'll convert to table later: Reserved monthly = (unit_price_gpu * 7 GPUs) * 730h; Burst credit = $Z per 1000 peak-minutes. Example numbers TBD after sim.

lina-ml: Warmup strategy: preheat common prompts and KV keys 10
mins before start of day via scheduled job. Warmup script runs across pool with parallelism 10. Worst-case per-worker warmup ~6 minutes. Fallback policy: route to quantized-small model automatically if latency > threshold for 30s.

ira-sre: Autoscale policy proposal: maintain base pool = 1.2x expected baseline, scale out in 2-worker increments with 180s cooldown, scale in after 10m stable. Separate burst lane: short-lived pre-provisioned warm slots that absorb 5-10min spikes.

ana-sales: Security Qs: KMS integration, customer key ownership, audit log retention, SOC2/ISO certs, VPC/private deployment options. Who will own the questionnaire?

sam-platform: I can draft answers: we support CMK integration (Bring-Your-Own-Key), logs to customer-owned S3 with configurable retention up to 12 months, SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 in our compliance pack, and Private deployment (VPC & on-prem) is available for enterprise.

rico-se: Also include details on tenant isolation for Dedicated pools and network egress controls.

ira-sre: Risk item: if customer enforces AZ-locality and single-AZ failover, we must include an explicit capacity buffer and call out RTO/RPO expectations.

ana-sales: OK action items: Sam to produce capacity + cost appendix with numbers for reserve vs reserve+burst; Lina to validate warmup times and fallback regression; Ira to write ops guidance and autoscale policy; Rico & Ana to assemble security answers. Deadline EOD for internal review, sending tomorrow.

infra-bot: deploy-job-4421 scheduled by sam-platform - warmup-run starting in 2m.

sam-platform: kicking off a quick simulator run now (mixed traffic 6k peak profile). I'll paste results when done.

lina-ml: ping me the sample prompts used for warmup so I can check hit rate after priming.

rico-se: noted. I'll add a short paragraph on fallback model accuracy tradeoffs for the questionnaire (expected delta in BLEU/ROUGE or acceptability).

ana-sales: Thanks folks. 2pm PT sync to finalize. :white_check_mark:
